properties.name: A record that names another design's record in its text is offered a typed link to it, and is flagged when their statuses disagree
properties.statement:
Where a requirement, decision or capability names a record of another design in its text (by id, with the design named or known from a declared dependency), reflow2 shall offer to record that mention as a typed cross-design link (req:a-relation-between-nodes-in-two-designs-is-recorded-in-the-design-that-makes-it), and shall flag when the two records' statuses disagree: a roll-up still planned whose named part is realized, or an idea still open here that the other design settled. It offers and flags; it never links or changes a status by itself, because each change is a write in a design with its own owner. It reads the references a record already writes, so it needs no similarity guess across designs written in different words.

Anthony, 2026-10-09, after the measured family check, chose "Narrow check as intent" and "After flo2.io upgrades", both the agent's recommendations. Grounded in fact:the-dev-reflow2-family-holds-five-facts-twice-and-a-similarity-sweep-finds-a-duplicate-one-time-in-eight-2026-10-09: 44 of 52 cross-design pairs a similarity sweep raised were real relations that name each other only in prose, and both drifts found were of this shape.
